Little Nemo (1911)

McCay’s first film — a bet, 4,000 drawings, and his Slumberland characters stretching, morphing, and riding a dragon through the dawn of animation.

Directed by Winsor McCay · Animation · Short
Content rating: Family-safe · Original aspect 1.33:1
